glosses: den Körper oder einen Körperteil in eine vollständig ausgestreckte Position bringen
etwas durch eine Öffnung, Lücke oder dergleichen so bewegen, dass es hindurchgeht

translations.source_sense_description: etwas in eine vollständig ausgestreckte Position bringen

examples.text: My cat likes stretching out in front of the fire.

glosses: To extend (something) fully, in space, time or use.

examples.text: You have to stretch your presentation out another two minutes.
Please don't stretch out your sweater by pulling it on and off carelessly.
We need to stretch the water supply out as long as we can.

glosses: To stretch (something or oneself) (To extend one’s limbs or another part of the body in order to improve the elasticity of one's muscles).

examples.text: You should stretch out your leg.
I need to stretch out or I'll be sore later.

translations.source_sense_description: etwas so bewegen, dass es hindurchgeht

glosses: To strike out (something); to draw a line through (something).

examples.text: If you make a mistake, just cross it out.

glosses: To disrespect (someone) by covering up or painting over their graffiti, especially their name.
To lie to or betray (someone); to deceive or scam (someone).
